name: language-service
description: The Zena language service, which gives editors diagnostics, completions and navigation

test:zena.#: The language server's Zena tests, run by the zena command's test runner from the repository root, which is where the service reads the standard library from. zena-lsp_test.zena runs the zena command's language server, so this needs the zena command built.

build:wasm.#command: 256MB of GC heap, not the 1536MB the compiler's own builds reserve: the reservation is an allocation, so it costs both startup time and resident memory, and this module's live set does not need it. Measured here — 128MB: 27s, 256MB: 6s/590MB, 512MB: 5s/1101MB, 1536MB: 6s/3150MB.
build:wasm.#dependencies: Stage A on zena-run, the way the CLI module itself is built: this module is the compiler and the language service, and building it with the zena command would wait for that command's module and binary, neither of which it needs. `cascade: false` on build:cli: its output is an input here, so this rebuilds when the compiler's bytes change.
build:wasm.command: cd ../.. && ZENA_GC_RESERVE_MB=256 ./target/release/zena-run --dir .::. --dir packages/stdlib/zena::/stdlib packages/zena-compiler/zena/out/cli.wasm packages/language-service/src/lsp.zena --target zena-js -g -o packages/language-service/lsp.wasm
